tests.report:
Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears (it may disappear again after a few seconds)
Observed failure: The app was already 'Gestoppt', so no Stop click was needed. I clicked 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and then Start with no stops selected. The refusal part works: the badge still showed 'Gestoppt', the Start button was still shown, Bahn 1 speed stayed at 0 cm/s and the event log showed no entries. The message part fails. The accessibility snapshot taken right after clicking Start had no 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' text. I clicked Start a second time and waited 3 seconds for the text. The wait timed out: Playwright found a toast element (div role="status") with the text 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen', but reported it as hidden throughout. A screenshot taken just after confirmed that no message was visible anywhere on the page. The message exists in the page but is never shown to the user.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes.
Observed failure: The status badge showed "In Fahrt", so I clicked Stop. The stop lists already matched (Bahn 1 was Haltestelle 2 then Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2 was Haltestelle 4 then Haltestelle 2), so I changed nothing and clicked Start. I took three screenshots, 8 seconds apart. Screenshot 1: Bahn 1 is at Haltestelle 2; Bahn 2 is on the lower main track between Haltestelle 3 and Weiche 3; they are clearly apart. Screenshot 2: Bahn 2 is still between Haltestelle 3 and Weiche 3; Bahn 1 is right at Weiche 3, almost touching Bahn 2's marker; both trains face each other on the same lower single track. Screenshot 3: the two trains have swapped sides; Bahn 1 is past Weiche 1 near Haltestelle 4, and Bahn 2 is past Weiche 3 near Haltestelle 2. The markers never overlapped exactly in any screenshot. However, the event log for this run has no "weicht aus" (evading) or "wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis" (waiting on the siding) entry. It shows only "Bahn 2 wartet" (14:20:46), "Bahn 1 wartet" (14:21:00), then "Bahn 1 fährt weiter" (14:21:09) and "Bahn 2 fährt weiter" (14:21:14). Earlier runs in the same log did show those evasion entries. So in screenshot 2 the trains appear to share the lower main track section at Weiche 3. They then got past each other with no logged evasion; whether Bahn 1 took the siding is not visible in the screenshots or the log.
Steps completed before failure: 9 (all steps were carried out; the third track screenshot had to be taken of the whole page because the graphic was re-rendering).
